name: Shell

offers.label: A workspace
offers.description: Adds a workspace, with one row, to `a`, and returns the row's key.

offers.label: A front workspace
offers.description: Adds the workspace in front, with its row in front, to `a`, and returns the row's key.

offers.label: A strip
offers.description: Adds a strip named `name` to `row` at `width`, and returns its key.

offers.label: A strip on
offers.description: Adds a strip named `name` to `row` at `width`, shown on `display`, and returns its key.

offers.label: A note place
offers.description: Adds a place showing the note at `index` of the notebook to `strip`, and returns its key.

offers.label: A foreign place
offers.description: A place of a kind this build has no document for: it stands as it is, which is what a place

offers.label: A query place
offers.description: Adds a place showing a search for `text` to `strip`, with the two matches the notes app

offers.label: Recents of an afternoon
offers.description: Ada's opens of an afternoon and two of Mia's, newest first, as the session lists them.
